title: カレンダーに印もつけてた

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And that's a wrap. All done with work for the day!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right, so, I'm here as a customer now! Time to grab some of those new cosmetics that came—

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Oh, did you have your eye on those? The customer just now took the last one!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nooo! You've gotta be kidding! That was what kept me motivated all day!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is feeling down after missing out on the cosmetics that she wanted.
